entities.summary: Albert György Gyula Mária Apponyi, Count of Nagyappony was a Hungarian aristocrat and politician. He was a board member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences, Chairman of Saint Stephen's Academy from 1921 to 1933, and a knight of the Austrian Golden Fleece from 1921. He was nominated for Nobel Peace Prize five times.
